components.name: pqscan
components.description: Post-quantum crypto scanner for Python projects (research prototype)

properties.name: pqscan:disclaimer
properties.value: Migration guidance only; does not establish that a migrated system is secure, compliant or quantum-safe.

properties.name: pqscan:target
properties.value: ML-DSA (FIPS 204); SLH-DSA (FIPS 205) where its size/speed trade-offs are acceptable

properties.name: pqscan:rationale
properties.value: Add ML-DSA (FIPS 204) verification so that migrated signers can be accepted. NIST IR 8547 defines 'legacy use' as processing already-protected data such as verifying an existing signature; whether RSA/ECC verification of already-issued signatures keeps that status after 2035 is set by SP 800-131A (to be revised). Retain legacy verification only for already-issued signatures; do not accept new RSA/ECC signatures after the transition.

properties.name: pqscan:reason
properties.value: key material (ANY, loaded-PEM) reaches SIG consumers only

properties.name: pqscan:parameterSet
properties.value: ML-DSA-65 (category 3) by default; ML-DSA-44 only with an RBG of >= 192-bit strength if category 2 is required; ML-DSA-87 for category 5

properties.name: pqscan:target

properties.name: pqscan:rationale

properties.name: pqscan:target
properties.value: Redesign as KEM + KDF + AEAD (KEM/DEM, SP 800-227 Secs. 2.1, 5.2); not a drop-in replacement for encrypt/decrypt

properties.name: pqscan:rationale
properties.value: RSA public-key encryption / key transport (PKCS#1 v1.5, OAEP) has no drop-in PQC replacement. Redesign as KEM + KDF + AEAD (SP 800-227 Secs. 2.1, 5.2): the sender encapsulates to the recipient's authenticated ML-KEM key, derives the content key from the shared secret (FIPS 203 Sec. 3.3), and encrypts with an AEAD. The existing encrypt(data) call shape cannot be preserved.

properties.name: pqscan:target
properties.value: Redesign as KEM + KDF + AEAD (KEM/DEM, SP 800-227 Secs. 2.1, 5.2); not a drop-in replacement for encrypt/decrypt

properties.name: pqscan:rationale
properties.value: RSA public-key decryption / key unwrapping has no drop-in PQC replacement. Redesign as KEM + KDF + AEAD (SP 800-227 Secs. 2.1, 5.2), decapsulation side: decapsulate with the ML-KEM decapsulation key, derive the content key from the shared secret (FIPS 203 Sec. 3.3), and decrypt with an AEAD. The existing decrypt(ciphertext) call shape cannot be preserved.
